```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)

# Path
p <- "../data/processed/changchangpan/capstone_llm_data_explore_r_outputs"
```


# Recommendation Rates by Model
```{r recc-rates-model}
read_csv(file.path(p, "recommendation_rates_by_model.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)%>%
  rename(Model = model_short) %>%
  kable(caption = "Recommendation Rates (%) by Model (n = 100 per model)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## Heatmap
```{r, fig.align = "center"}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(p, "medication_rates_by_model_heatmap.png"))
```


# Range Across Models
```{r range-models}
read_csv(file.path(p, "model_to_model_feature_ranges.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)%>%
  arrange(desc(range_pct_points)) %>%
  rename(Feature = feature, `Min %` = min_pct, `Max %` = max_pct,
         `Range (pp)` = range_pct_points) %>%
  kable(caption = "Range in Recommendation Rates Across Models (percentage
        points)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```


# Inter-Model Agreement
```{r intermodel-agreement}
read_csv(file.path(p, "model_agreement_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(pct_agree) %>%
  rename(Feature = feature, `N vignettes` = n_cases,
         `All agree` = n_agree, `Any disagreement` = n_disagree,
         `% agreement` = pct_agree) %>%
  kable(caption = "Agreement Across all 3 Models (97 evaluable vignettes)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```


# High-Disagreement Cases
```{r high-disagreement-cases}
read_csv(file.path(p, "high_disagreement_cases.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(disagreement_score >= 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(disagreement_score)) %>%
  rename(`Case ID` = case_id, `# drugs disagreed` = disagreement_score,
         `Disagreed features` = disagreed_features) %>%
  kable(caption = "Cases with Disagreement on 3+ Drug Classes") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```


# Guideline Adherence by Model
```{r guideline-adherence-model}
read_csv(file.path(p, "exploratory_guideline_flags.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(Condition = condition, Feature = feature, Model = model_short,
         N = n, `%` = pct) %>%
  kable(caption = "Guideline Adherence Flags by Condition and Model") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, valign = "top")
```

## Guideline Adherence Plots
```{r guideline-adherence-plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
read_csv(file.path(p, "exploratory_guideline_flags.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(condition, "\n(", feature, ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_short, y = pct, fill = model_short)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Claude Opus 4.6" = "blue",
    "Claude Sonnet 4.6" = "purple",
    "GPT-5.4" = "red"
  )) +
  labs(title = "Guideline adherence rates by condition and model",
       x = NULL, y = "% of vignettes", fill = "Model") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```


# Manual Review Flags
```{r manual-review}
read_csv(file.path(p, "manual_review_flags.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(case_id, model_short, egfr_ml_min_1_73m2, hba1c_percent,
         possible_low_egfr_metformin_issue, metformin_parser_conflict,
         sglt2i_parser_conflict, glp1_parser_conflict,
         severe_hyperglycemia_no_insulin, financial_no_cost_mention) %>%
  filter(if_any(c(possible_low_egfr_metformin_issue, metformin_parser_conflict,
                  sglt2i_parser_conflict, glp1_parser_conflict,
                  severe_hyperglycemia_no_insulin, financial_no_cost_mention),
                ~ . == TRUE)) %>%
  rename(`Case ID` = case_id, Model = model_short,
         
         eGFR = egfr_ml_min_1_73m2, HbA1c = hba1c_percent,
         
         `Low eGFR/metformin` = possible_low_egfr_metformin_issue,
         
         `Metformin conflict` = metformin_parser_conflict,
         
         `SGLT2i conflict` = sglt2i_parser_conflict,
         
         `GLP-1 conflict` = glp1_parser_conflict,
         
         `Severe HG/no insulin` = severe_hyperglycemia_no_insulin,
         
         `Financial/no cost mention` = financial_no_cost_mention) %>%
  kable(caption = "Cases Flagged for Potential Guideline Issues or Parser Conflicts") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), font_size = 11)
```


# Exploratory Regression Results

## GEE Results
```{r gee-results}
read_csv(file.path(p, "exploratory_gee_results.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
  rename(Outcome = outcome, Term = term, OR = estimate,
         SE = std.error, Statistic = statistic,
         `p-value` = p.value, `CI low` = conf.low, `CI high` = conf.high) %>%
  kable(caption = "GEE Results (odds ratios) - Exploratory") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), font_size = 11) %>%
  scroll_box(height = "400px")
```

## Logistic Regression Results
```{r log-reg-results}
read_csv(file.path(p, "exploratory_logistic_regression_results.csv"),
         show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
  rename(Outcome = outcome, Term = term, OR = estimate,
         SE = std.error, Statistic = statistic,
         `p-value` = p.value, `CI low` = conf.low, `CI high` = conf.high) %>%
  kable(caption = "Logistic Regression Results (odds ratios) - Exploratory") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), font_size = 11) %>%
  scroll_box(height = "400px")
```
